'''Pallista Spaceport''' was a spaceport located on the [[Apalis Coast]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], serving as the main spaceport for the nearby [[Castle Organa|Organa Palace]], home of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], the forces of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] tried to destroy the spaceport with [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] bombs. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Viic]] sold [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrades in the spaceport.
